item.title: C-Programming (Full Notes For GATE)
item.description:
Syllabus For Fundamental Of C-Programming

  • Token in C-programming
  • Keywords/Operators/String/Constant/Identifier
  • Special Character
  • int, char, float (signed and unsigned), short and long

Tokens in C

  1. Keywords
  2. Operators
  3. Identifiers
  4. Constants
  5. Special Symbols
  6. String

Keywords

  • auto, double, int, struct, switch ……. (total 32)

Identifier

  • Name of a variable || Name of a function.
constraint for identifier
  1. Can’t be start with digit, only letter || underscore followed by digit
  2. No special keyword should be used.

C is a Case sensitive language a and A are treaated different.
